messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Barnes <rachel.barnes@brightforge.health>
Date: 2028-07-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro request: BrightForge AWS co-sell + MA plan and licensing check

Hi Kim & Karthik,

Quick one — BrightForge (cc’d: Rachel) is moving toward a pilot and asked for a co-sell intro with AWS. They want to align on a mutual-action plan (MA plan) and validate licensing options (per-seat vs. instance-based) that affect pricing and procurement timing.

Can you help with:
- A short MA plan we can present (timeline, milestones, who owns what)
- Confirmation on any licensing constraints for deployment on AWS Marketplace (SaaS listing vs. AMI/provisioned)
- A proposed 30–45m alignment call with AWS and BrightForge next week

I attached a rough MA plan BrightForge shared and their SLA questions so you have context. If this looks like a good fit, Kim can you draft the marketplace/ops readout? Karthik, can you loop in the AWS partner contact and confirm availability for a call?

Thanks — Sean

--

Subject: Re: Intro request: BrightForge AWS co-sell + MA plan and licensing check

Thanks Sean — appreciate the quick intro.

Short context on our side: we’re an EHR-adjacent analytics vendor; pilot aims to run inference on patient de-identified data in a customer VPC. Budget authority is in procurement; security team flagged marketplace licensing models as a gating item. Our pilot target: Aug 15 start, 6-week pilot.

Availability for call next week (PST):
- Tue 7/18: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 7/19: 09:00–11:00

Attachments: I uploaded the MA plan BrightForge used with another vendor — it’s the one Sean attached (BrightForge_MAPlan_20280710.xlsx). Also added a short note with our licensing preferences.

Open questions for the alignment call:
1) Which marketplace listing path (SaaS vs. AMI) keeps our data-in-customer-VPC requirement intact?
2) Are there any additional AWS procurement controls for pilot-stage credits?
3) Expected timeline for co-sell enablement once we agree to listing path.

Happy to sync — Rachel

Marcus — looping you in to coordinate a short alignment call. BrightForge (cc’d) is aiming for a mid-August pilot. Key asks:
- Confirm marketplace listing recommendations (SaaS listing that preserves customer VPC vs. AMI/workload model)
- Clarify procurement/credit runway for pilot stage
- Fast-path checklist for co-sell enablement (required docs & timelines)

Availability from BrightForge: Tue 7/18 morning or Wed 7/19 morning (PST). Can you propose two 30–45m slots on your side?

Thanks, Karthik

Thanks for the intro. High-level: we can support a SaaS Marketplace listing that keeps compute in the customer VPC via Private Offers/Private SaaS integrations (still requires a technical integration review). For pilots, AWS can offer co-sell credits in some ISV acceleration programs — we’ll need a short intake form and minimal security artifacts.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 7/19 09:30–10:15
- Thu 7/20 11:00–11:45

Next steps (short list):
1) Kimberly — can you prepare a 1-page Marketplace Ops readout: listing path recommended, dev/ops checklist, and any KMS/KV requirements for the customer-VPC flow.
2) BrightForge/Rachel — please confirm preferred slot (7/19 09:30 or 7/20 11:00) and share any additional pilot artifacts (current infra diagram, basic SOC2 snapshot).
3) Karthik/Sean — I’ll send the AWS co-sell intake link once we confirm the slot.

I attached an internal checklist (SLA and intake fields) as a stub for the call.

—Marcus
